ex.s: I experienced years of loneliness as a child. ___31___ His friends teased him about babysitting his sister and his interests were far different from mine.

ex.s: With pleasant flavours and scents, and coming in a variety of colours, fruit and herbal teas make a nice change to traditional teas.

ex.s: Many people grow their very own tea gardens, in which they plant easy-to-grow herbs such as mint and lemongrass.
ex.t: 许多人种植自己的茶园,其中种植薄荷和柠檬草等容易生长的草药.
